thread:
Asha Verma: massive shoutout to Ben and Riley for the midnight cronut rescue  demo traffic spike + sticky cache combo could've been ugly, but you two kept the UI smooth. truly appreciated! :sparkles: :croissant:

Ben Cho: thanks! Riley found a bad memcache key that was returning stale feature flags. flushed the key and rolled the small canary. :wrench:

Riley Morgan: pushed a short fix to the cache key generation so it includes the deploy-id. small change but should prevent repeat. added the snippet to the runbook. :memo:

Dina Flores: also huge props to infra-bot alerts which pointed us to the exact host. I left a tiny stash of cronuts in the kitchen (labelled "croissant coalition") at 9am for the crew. please sign the sticky so I know who grabbed one. :doughnut:

infra-bot: incident #2199: stale_cache_key detected on web-agg-7. Mitigation: cache_flush executed by Ben Cho. Acknowledged. :white_check_mark:

Ben Cho: repro steps I left in the thread for engineers who want to understand the failure pattern:

Ben Cho: ```bash
# find stale keys
redis-cli -h cache.internal keys "feature:*deploy-*" | xargs -n1 redis-cli -h cache.internal get
# flush single key
redis-cli -h cache.internal del "feature:user-123:deploy-2026-04-01"
```

Riley Morgan: pairing offer: i'll walk through the fix tomorrow at 10am for 10m if anyone wants a quick explainer. coffee and cronuts for attendees. :coffee:

Asha Verma: adding this to the weekly kudos email under "Midnight micro-saves". Ben/Riley  you're on the hall-of-thanks list. Thanks for being calm and fast. :clap:

culture-bot: kudos recorded: recipients: Ben Cho, Riley Morgan. Reason: "Fixed stale cache key during demo spike, kept UI healthy". :tada:

Dina Flores: one cronut left in the kitchen. first come, first served. leave your name if you take it! :sparkling_heart:

Ben Cho: dibs (i did the heavy lifting, naturally :) ) :grin:
